title: Dashboard Confessional 2027: Where to Shop Affordable Unplugged 25th Anniversary Tour Tickets Online
summary: Starting on Mar. 12, the iconic emo band hits the road with 14 tour dates across the United States.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Dashboard Confessional is on tour in 2027 in support of the iconic MTV Unplugged 2.0 live album, which was released in December 2002. Starting at The Salt Shed in Chicago, Illinois on Friday (Mar. 12), the tour has just 14 dates throughout the United States with dates in Los Angeles, Brooklyn, Boston, Philadelphia and other cities. It ends at The Masonic in San Francisco, California in early April 2027.

shop Dashboard confessional tour Tickets At Ticketmaster

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the ticket retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find Dashboard Confessional tickets online is through third-party sites, such as StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.

Where to Find Dashboard Confessional Unplugged: 25th Anniversary Tour 2027 Tickets Online

EDITOR'S PICK

Find Dashboard Confessional Tickets at StubHub

find tickets at StubHub

Top choice for concert tickets.

StubHub has all-in pricing, so all fees are listed upfront. The site’s “FanProtect Guarantee” ensures that tickets are valid and delivered in time for the concert. If not, you’ll get your money back. In addition, if the concert is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% credit or be offered a full refund without the extra credit. At the time of publishing, Dashboard Confessional tickets start at $110.

Find Dashboard Confessional Tickets at Vivid Seats

FIND TICKETS at Vivid Seats

Vivid Seats lets you search by type of seat, such as suite, standing room, front of section or the VIP section, while the retailer prioritizes “Super Sellers” who are “experienced, highly rated sellers.” With Vivid Seats, your purchase is protected with the company’s “100% Buyer Guarantee,” which ensures that you receive legitimate tickets in time for your concert or your money back.

FIND TICKETS at SeatGeek

Tickets are delivered digitally via email, so they’re available on your phone before you go through security. And prices are surprisingly reasonable, even for the hottest tickets. For example, SeatGeek has cheap Dashboard Confessional tickets online from $109. Use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

PROMO CODE

Find Dashboard Confessional Tickets at TicketNetwork

find tickets at TicketNetwork

TicketNetwork has ticket packages, which include parking passes, VIP access, meet and greets and other great experiences. It has tickets to Dashboard Confessional concerts with all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll pay up front (fees included). Tickets start at $117, as of this writing. You can use our exclusive code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off purchases over $500, or BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1000 and up.

And since TicketNetwork is a resale site, the company says that pricing may sometimes be below face value because tickets aren’t held to a specific price point. It guarantees that the tickets you receive are the ones you purchased, and sometimes, even better than expected.

SEATING OPTIONS

Find Dashboard Confessional Tickets at Gametime

find tickets at Gametime

Gametime is a stellar third-party retailer for fans looking for affordable tickets. Tickets for in-demand concerts like Dashboard Confessional start at $93. It guarantees the lowest prices, event cancellation protection and on-time ticket delivery for a smooth ticket-buying experience.
